entities.summary: Tamer Hosny (b. 1977-08-16, Al Ahram) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Al Ahram and Egypt. Known in the fields of egypt, composers & musicians, africa.
